title: Powering Instant Payments Through Embedded Banking: Astra + Treasury Prime
summary: Discover how Astra and Treasury Prime help banks scale instant payments, including real-time account funding and disbursements, through a single API
body_markdown:
Offering instant payments is no longer optional. But for many banks, building the necessary infrastructure in-house is costly, complex and slow.


By using Astra integrated with Treasury Prime’s Bank OS, banks don’t have to wait months to get started — they can launch real-time payments products in weeks.


Curious how your bank can support diverse instant payment flows through a single API?


**Discover the combined power of Treasury Prime and Astra.**[Download the Case Study](https://go.treasuryprime.com/rs/253-WQB-828/images/Treasury%20Prime_Astra%20Case%20Study_2025.pdf?version=0) **.**
